comparison.objective: Unplug a failed-on power tool and leave it safely de-energized; candidate removes and recovers insert tangs.
comparison.physical_skill: Safety task tests fault recognition, plug extraction, and restraint from unsafe reconnection; candidate tests precision impact tooling and debris handling.
comparison.success_condition: Trigger released, fault noticed, plug pulled, tool stopped and left unplugged; candidate requires four safe fractures, intact inserts and shell, and four tangs in a tray.
comparison.reason: Emergency de-energization tests safety sequencing rather than controlled fracture and component finishing.
